title: A Bell for the Choir
author: Wendell Eastwick
blurb: Isandro Dunmore, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
